text: The hook contains surprising facts and is a good starting point for research as it addresses a problem that older people want to learn something new but cannot for various reasons.
The current approach to support learning for older people is identified and its limitations in guidance are highlighted.
The question here is whether learning experience and learning progress are mutually exclusive in the first place. Maybe you mean the learning speed instead of the learning progress.
A research question that can be easily investigated because the estimated time and the actual time required can be easily compared.

You have planned a quantitative analysis in your schedule. For a quantitative analysis, you need comparable metrics for the case study. However, these are heavily distorted by the individual survey and objectives. How do you want to counteract this distortion to make them comparable?
What are your criterias for a suitable model?
You have worked out the essential challenges due to the individual nature of the LLMs.
The time schedule seems realistic and your research questions have been linked to the corresponding time frames. Perhaps milestones in the schedule could better ensure the progress of the project.
